_comment: Copy this file to model_config.json and fill in real values. Top-level keys are model names (model-key); any key starting with 'embedding' is reserved and never used as the default chat model. Shared by BOTH backends (construct.light and construct.api_based). See README.md > Configuration.
_comment_api_key: Both backends resolve API keys through api_key_env names loaded from the project-root .env. Do not place secrets in this JSON file.

embedding._comment: Local in-process embeddings via sentence-transformers. No /v1/embeddings HTTP server is needed.

belief_graph._comment: Shared construct settings. The light backend reads the full section; the api_based backend reads belief_graph.confidence relation-confidence propagation fields so run.py and online_server.py use the same parameters.

extractor._comment: Generative node extractor: a small model (Qwen) behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. vLLM). Every semantic chunk of a turn is extracted concurrently into zero or more belief/decision nodes. Replaces the former local DistilBART summarizer. Stance, entities, and event_time are NOT produced here (handled by the stance classifier, post-merge NER, and the graph builder).

stance._comment: Required local English four-class zero-shot statement-stance classifier. It runs on each exact semantic chunk before belief/decision/evidence creation; no asserted fallback is used.

asserted.description: The speaker presents this as a direct and definite assertion, without framing it as a memory, inference, judgment, guess, or uncertainty.

recalled.description: The speaker presents this as something remembered or recalled from past experience or memory.

judged.description: The speaker presents this as a judgment, assessment, interpretation, conclusion, or inference rather than a directly observed fact.

speculated.description: The speaker presents this as a guess, possibility, prediction, hypothesis, or otherwise uncertain speculation.

edge_generation._comment: Non-thinking Qwen edge generator. It receives all nodes from one two-turn window after incremental merge and may return no edges.

entities._comment: Local named-entity recognition runs only after a merge round is complete and canonical node summaries are stable. Supported methods: pattern, rules, ml, huggingface. regex and llm are rejected.

confidence._comment: Confidence policy. initial_confidence comes from source reliability and stance quality; evidence_confidence accumulates merged evidence; factor_confidence is propagated through active relations.
confidence._propagation_comment: depends_on propagates positive support from to_id to from_id; contradicts propagates negative support from from_id to to_id; supplements is semantic-only and uses null weight/activated_condition.

chunking._comment: SemanticSplitterNodeParser-style adjacent embedding-distance breakpoint chunking, shared by run.py and online_server.py.
